description: List NF pipelines as path/title metadata from 03_管线库 and community/*/pipelines. Use it to discover a pipeline ID before pipeline_read; do not use it to fetch pipeline text (use pipeline_read instead), module metadata (registry_search), or protocol packages (spec_list). The optional query is a case-sensitive substring of the repository-relative path or H1 title, not file content; wildcard characters are literal. Omit it to list every pipeline (examples: P04, 技术文档, 校园). Returns metadata only, never pipeline bodies, sorted by repository path; no matches yields an empty list, and each call rescans the repository. Local-only; no auth or rate limits.

query.description: Case-sensitive substring matched against the relative path and H1 title; omit to list every pipeline.

name: pipeline_list

outputSchema.description: Wrapper for the pipeline list; the payload is in items.

items.description: Pipelines matching query, sorted by repository path.

title.description: H1 heading text, or an empty string when absent.

title: List pipelines
